mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resumes ( user_id, filename, file_size, file_hash, content_type, resume_text, analyze_status, analyze_error, latest_score, access_count, interview_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{filename}, #{fileSize}, #{fileHash}, #{contentType}, #{resumeText}, #{analyzeStatus}, #{analyzeError}, #{latestScore}, COALESCE(#{accessCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{interviewCount}, 0), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE resumes SET filename = #{filename}, file_size = #{fileSize}, file_hash = #{fileHash}, content_type = #{contentType}, resume_text = #{resumeText}, analyze_status = #{analyzeStatus}, analyze_error = #{analyzeError}, latest_score = #{latestScore}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, filename, file_size as fileSize, file_hash as fileHash, content_type as contentType, resume_text as resumeText, analyze_status as analyzeStatus, analyze_error as analyzeError, latest_score as latestScore, access_count as accessCount, interview_count as interviewCount, created_at::timestamp as createdAt, updated_at::timestamp as updatedAt FROM resumes WHERE id = #{id}
